result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. Found a few minor issues: horizontally clipped content in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge) and a category chip partially cut off, which are normal carousel behaviors but the name truncation without clear scroll affordance could confuse users. No critical or major visual breakage detected.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card's restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/clipped at the right screen edge without an ellipsis, making it look cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade/gradient mask or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrollability, and ensure truncated names use an ellipsis (…) so the cutoff looks intentional.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') has an additional chip partially visible/clipped at the right edge with no visual cue that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge gradient or scroll hint so users know the category list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card shows '-0%', which is a meaningless discount value and looks like a data/placeholder error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, or populate it with a real promotional percentage.
